inputs.text: This looks less like a spontaneous response and more like a carefully managed political spectacle. Hundreds of groups were involved, and holding the rally weeks before local elections gives the timing a purpose: keep the far-right threat front and centre and steer what voters are allowed to focus on. The “stand against extremism” framing may be the cover; mass rallies can also signal which views are acceptable and funnel public opinion where the organisers want it. I wouldn’t assume this was organic.

output.main_topic: Suspected strategic purpose of a political rally before local elections
subtopics: Influence on voter attention and public opinion
